participant_1.name: Mike
participant_1.personality: Creative and introspective, Mike enjoys deep conversations and has a passion for music.
participant_1.background: I'm a recording engineer and own my own studio. I live in California but the recording artist market was dead last year. I am a 46-year-old single dad with kids. My ex cheated and left me for a lawyer. I prefer being inside.
